attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the DHCP server on eth1, the private network shared with node2/node3's ens7. Added a static DHCP host reservation keyed to node2's ens7 MAC (192.168.50.50) so it always gets the same address, while node3 is served dynamically from the general pool (192.168.50.100-249, currently .208). Verified stability by releasing/renewing node2's lease and confirming the same IP was reissued. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3, confirming boot_id changes and post-restart recovery of the router config/service and both nodes' correct addressing on each.
